items.title: Thermo Fisher Scientific (TMO) Wins Wider FDA Clearance For Blood Cancer Monitoring
items.summary: Thermo Fisher Scientific (NYSE:TMO) received expanded FDA clearance for its EXENT Analyser with the Immunoglobulin Isotypes (GAM) Assay. The decision covers use in monitoring multiple myeloma and Waldenström's macroglobulinemia, broadening the EXENT system's clinical utility. The GAM Assay is intended to support more detailed tracking of disease activity and treatment response in complex blood cancer patients.
